scope: Focused realism revision; some sources overlap the initial register. Not 28 new independent studies.

sources.title: OpenAI image prompting
sources.supported_claim: Concrete photo descriptions, reference roles, narrow edits and explicit preservation. Pixel-identical preservation may require compositing.
sources.caveat: Provider examples are not an independent realism benchmark or proof of exposed Higgsfield controls.

sources.title: OpenAI image generation limitations
sources.supported_claim: Limitations remain in precise text, repeated identity or brand consistency, and structured composition.
sources.caveat: Do not infer numerical error rates from qualitative limitations.

sources.title: Gemini API image generation
sources.supported_claim: Purpose, scene specificity, photographic language, small revisions and semantic positive descriptions guide generation.
sources.caveat: Conversation examples do not prove cross-job state in Higgsfield; provider features must be resolved against its current surface.

sources.title: Google DeepMind Gemini Image prompt guide
sources.supported_claim: Specify style, subject, setting, action and composition; use clear named reference subjects.
sources.caveat: General image direction is not identity preservation certification.

sources.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 photorealistic images
sources.supported_claim: FLUX.2 photoreal prompting uses photographic framing, lens, lighting and visible texture.
sources.caveat: Imperfection examples are prompting advice, not mandatory blemishes or measured visual guarantees.

sources.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 prompting guide
sources.supported_claim: Camera/lens cues and explicit reference roles; natural language and structured prompts are both documented.
sources.caveat: The guide's exact-control language is not proof that every output follows a calibrated camera or exact color.

sources.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image style, aesthetics and text
sources.supported_claim: Specify medium and visible photographic effects; light source, direction, quality and interaction with surfaces.
sources.caveat: Document mixes clearly labeled older-model examples with FLUX 3 examples; do not transfer model controls blindly.

sources.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image technical parameters
sources.supported_claim: No negative_prompt field; changing generation resolution can change composition.
sources.caveat: Provider request fields and resolution choices are not automatically Higgsfield controls.

sources.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image single-reference editing
sources.supported_claim: Identify a unique target, the specific change and protected details. Location controls are documented for ambiguous targets.
sources.caveat: Local preservation must be inspected. Box layouts require the actual compatible input route.

sources.title: ByteDance Seedream 4.0/4.5/5.0 Lite prompt guide
sources.access: official search-index excerpt; direct page returned JavaScript shell
sources.supported_claim: Concise connected natural language, subject/action/environment, explicit use and edit preservation.
sources.caveat: Version scope excludes blanket transfer to Pro or Flash; full direct retrieval unavailable.

sources.title: ByteDance Seedream 5.0 Pro introduction
sources.supported_claim: Provider describes material/light/skin handling, regional edits and references, and acknowledges remaining pixel-level editing consistency limits.
sources.caveat: Showcases and marketing are not independent measurement, and some provider controls may not be exposed by Higgsfield.

sources.title: Higgsfield Soul family help
sources.supported_claim: Soul family variants differ; Moodboards combine coherent style references; documented web references disable text prompts.
sources.caveat: Check live connector behavior separately. Identity-consistency marketing is not a measured guarantee.

sources.title: Higgsfield Soul Cinema help
sources.supported_claim: Soul Cinema has built-in cinematic styling, supports Soul HEX/ID, and differs from Soul 2.0 presets and Moodboards.
sources.caveat: Claims about avoiding an AI aesthetic are product positioning, not blind-viewer evidence.

sources.title: Google video generation prompt guide
sources.access: Full page and relevant lens/camera sections read
claims: Camera vocabulary expresses specific movements and framing.
Advanced camera angles and lens concepts are not all officially supported and reliability varies.
caveats: This is not a guarantee of calibrated optical simulation or exposure of every control through Higgsfield.

sources.title: Google best practices for generating videos
sources.access: Full page and specific recommendations read
claims: Short videos should focus on a single moment.
Use a clear source image and primarily motion-focused I2V prompts.
The guide recommends avoiding quoted dialogue to reduce rendered text.
caveats: The guide's identity/seed advice is directional; a seed is not proof of consistency.
Provider features may differ from Higgsfield's active route.

sources.title: ByteDance: One-take Creation, Flexible Referencing, Introducing Seedance 2.5
sources.access: Full page and specific limitations, clay-render and editing sections read
claims: Documents clay-render reference conditioning and targeted timestamp-based edits.
Admits remaining physical plausibility and multi-subject interaction limitations.
caveats: Quality claims and showcased outputs are vendor statements.
No first-attempt success rate or deterministic geometry guarantee.

sources.title: Kling image-to-video guide
claims: Recommends simple subject/background motion instructions.
Movement should fit the input image; substantial departures may trigger cuts.
Complex physical movements are challenging in the documented version.
caveats: Guide carries 2025 date; current version controls must be discovered.

sources.title: Google DeepMind Veo model overview
sources.access: Full page and limitations section read
claims: Identifies remaining natural spoken-audio and synchronization limitations.
caveats: Preference charts are vendor benchmarks, not undetectability or factual provenance tests.

sources.title: T2VPhysBench: A First-Principles Benchmark for Physical Consistency in Text-to-Video Generation
sources.access: Abstract, methods/model list, hint ablation and limitations sections read
claims: In the tested model set, adding detailed law-specific hints generally did not cure physical failures.
Some law-specific improvements occurred, so prompts were not uniformly ineffective.
caveats: Published May 2025, evaluated older models.
No current Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 or Veo performance estimate follows.
Do not turn benchmark compliance scores into viewer detection probabilities.

sources.title: Kling Motion Control user guide
claims: Motion-reference input should match framing, provide a visible single subject and continuous moderate movement.
Facial Element reference does not carry clothing, hairstyle, makeup or props.
Facial Element binding is subject to orientation requirements.
caveats: Provider controls do not establish availability in Higgsfield.
Marketing statements such as perfect consistency are not adopted.
Provider credit prices are not copied into the skill.

sources.title: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 Motion Control Standard API reference
sources.access: Full page and parameter table read
claims: Public Standard route documents image/video input, character orientation and retention of original sound.
caveats: Public REST API is not identical to the active connector schema.
The table does not establish provider facial Element binding through this route.

sources.title: MechVerse: Evaluating Physical Motion Consistency in Video Generation Models
sources.access: Abstract read; full paper not reviewed
claims: Reports that appearance and smoothness can coexist with invalid mechanical coupling or motion.
caveats: Preprint marked under review.
Not independently reproduced; no current route ranking is inferred.

sources.title: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
sources.access: Abstract read; full paper not reviewed
claims: Separates perceptual plausibility from temporal and biomechanical motion fidelity.
caveats: Not independently reproduced; abstract does not establish present Higgsfield model success rates.

sources.title: ARRI ALEXA Studio electronic and mirror shutter white paper
sources.access: Official indexed excerpt read; PDF open returned internal error
claims: Real-camera exposure duration depends on frame rate and shutter angle.
Longer exposure increases motion blur.
caveats: Applies to actual capture, not proof that a generator simulates these values.
Full PDF not inspected.

sources.title: Blender 5.4 manual, Cycles motion blur
sources.access: Official indexed excerpt read; page open returned HTTP 402
claims: Render shutter exposure interval is measured in frames.
caveats: Verify installed Blender version and render engine before applying a setting.
Full page not inspected.

sources.title: VBench-2.0 project and paper abstract
claims: Separates visual appeal and temporal coherence from anatomy, physics and commonsense faithfulness.
caveats: The skill does not implement this benchmark or claim its scores. Project page and abstract read; no reproduction performed.

sources.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy
claims: Human ratings in the studied GAN face task did not make visual plausibility equivalent to actual photographic origin.
caveats: Specific face datasets, participants and task; not current Higgsfield footage or proof of general audience detection rates.

sources.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones
claims: Reports a White-face hyperrealism effect and mismatch between participant confidence and performance in the studied tasks.
caveats: Demographic and task-specific findings cannot be generalized to South African audiences, full scenes or current Higgsfield models. Abstract read; no study reproduction.
